items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I worked with Big Green a long time in Benny Carter's band.

ctx.x: Did you know Big Green, the trombone player (inaudible)?
Yeah, I worked with Big Green a long time in Benny Carter's band. Yeah, he was a great sax and trombone player. Always hit those long notes for us, he was powerful.

Big Green was funny, too, You know, he always -- he drank very heavily. He drank on a system. He'd drink on the night -- on the job he'd drink a pint of whisky during the evening and he went to work every night with two and a half pints of whisky that he'd knock off during the three hours of the dance when we were working the Empire Ballroom. And any musician who asked him for a drink he'd say, "I just have enough for myself. I'll lend you some money so you can go buy yourself some but I can't give you any of…
